- 来源: `er_semantic_query` (db=debit_card_specializing)、`er_search_evidence` [kid=8 单位价格=总价/总量]、`get_entity_mapping`、Ch3 skill "Who is the top spending customer…"
- Top 客户由 `yearmonth` 全量月度消费求和判定(kid=19 粒度:总消费用 yearmonth);均价用 `transactions_1k` 求和相除(非按行均值,符合 skill 与 kid=8)

Final Answer: Top spending customer is Customer 12459 with an average price per single item of 22.5452, using CZK as the billing currency.
Evidence SQL: SELECT top.CustomerID, (SELECT SUM(Price)/SUM(Amount) FROM transactions_1k WHERE CustomerID = top.CustomerID) AS avg_price_per_item, c.Currency FROM (SELECT CustomerID FROM yearmonth GROUP BY CustomerID ORDER BY SUM(Consumption) DESC LIMIT 1) top JOIN customers c ON c.CustomerID = top.CustomerID;
